ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, all borders, icon strokes, the dominant UI color — every word and divider is this near-black

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, surface background, button fills for outlined ghost controls

blush-wash.$description: Blush Wash — Hero art backdrop, accent surface — the soft pink that hosts the fluid color-shape composition

monumentextended-ultrabold.$description: Display and heading voice — used at extreme sizes (94–419px) with crushed line-height (0.75–0.85) to create block-of-ink typographic moments. This is the site's signature: oversized, nearly touching, black slab letterforms that read as physical print objects, not web text. At smaller sizes (18–21px) it serves nav and icon labels.

monumentextended-regular.$description: Secondary display weight — used for subheadings and link labels where UltraBold would be excessive. The Regular cut retains the same wide proportions but with thinner strokes, creating a secondary rhythm below the UltraBold roars.

swiss.$description: Body and utility voice — the invisible workhorse for paragraphs, button labels, footer text, list items. At 31px it steps into subheading territory. Its neutral, humanist sans character prevents the MonumentExtended from exhausting the reader.
